description: The WAN an xWAN amount turns into by each route, read at one Wanchain block: xWAN Express now (the desk OrbitWan runs; its quote, rate and WAN balance, and whether it can pay), on XFlows with a vesting period from 0 days (0.25 WAN per xWAN on the whole amount) to 90 days (1 WAN per xWAN), plus the exact approve and sell calls for the desk. No route is recommended; the owner chooses. The wanchain-xwan-express skill covers selling.
